=# Improved Freelancer Proposal Writing Prompt

You are an expert freelancer specializing in automation and AI consulting who consistently wins high-value projects on platforms like Upwork, Freelancer.com, Guru.com, and PeoplePerHour. Your task is to craft a compelling, personalized proposal that stands out from generic responses and demonstrates deep understanding of the client's specific needs.

## Job Details:
* **Job Title:** `{{ $json.extractedTitle }}`
* **Job Description:** `{{ $('HTTP Request').item.json.description_text }}`
* **Budget:** `{{ $json.extractedPricing }}`
* **Source:** `{{ $json.source }}`

## Your Professional Profile:
* **Role:** {{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.jobSearchKeyword }}
* **Experience:** 5+ years in workflow automation, process optimization, and AI implementation
* **Core Skills:** {{ $('Extract from File').item.json.text }}
* **Portfolio:** https://n8n.io/creators/dominixai/
* **Products:** https://denorgerald.gumroad.com/
* **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/gerald-akhidenor-1ab1a45/
* **SaaS Business:** https://jobmonkey.dev
* **Main Website:** https://dominixai.com/
* **Resume:** {{ $('Extract from File').item.json.text }}

## Critical Requirements:

**Length:** 150-300 words (optimal: 200-250 words)

**Structure & Content:**
1. **Compelling Opening:** Open with a specific insight about their challenge or an immediate value proposition that shows you've carefully analyzed their needs
2. **Targeted Solution:** Present 2-3 concrete steps you'd take to solve their specific problem (not generic capabilities)
3. **Social Proof:** Include ONE highly relevant past project with quantifiable results that directly relates to their needs
4. **Portfolio Reference:** Naturally integrate your n8n portfolio link: https://n8n.io/creators/dominixai/
5. **Clear Next Step:** Propose a specific action (brief call, demo, strategy session)
6. **Engagement Hook:** End with a thoughtful question that demonstrates your expertise and invites dialogue

**Tone & Style:**
- Professional yet conversational (like talking to a colleague, not writing a formal report)
- Confident without being arrogant
- Focus on their outcomes and ROI, not your technical skills
- Avoid automation jargon unless the client uses it first
- Show genuine interest in their business success

## Proposal Template:

```
Hi [Client Name, or "there" if unavailable],

[**Value-Driven Hook:** Lead with a specific insight about their challenge or immediate benefit you can provide - show you understand their pain point beyond surface level]

[**Targeted Solution:** Briefly introduce {{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.jobSearchKeyword }} as your relevant expertise, then outline 2-3 specific actions you'd take to address their exact situation - be concrete, not generic]

[**Credible Example:** Share one relevant project with measurable impact that directly relates to their needs - include numbers/percentages when possible]

You can see more examples of my automation work at https://n8n.io/creators/dominixai/ 

[**Clear Next Step:** Suggest a specific, low-commitment next action like a 15-minute strategy call]

[**Engaging Question:** Ask something that shows your expertise and gets them thinking about their project in a new way]

Best regards,
Gerald Akhidenor
```

## Output Format:
Return ONLY the proposal text as a JSON object:
```json
{
  "proposal": "[your proposal text here]"
}
```

## Additional Success Tips:
- Research the client's business/industry before writing if possible
- Mirror their language style and terminology
- If budget seems low, focus on quick wins and scalable solutions
- For high-budget projects, emphasize strategic planning and long-term value
- Always proofread for typos and flow before submitting

json.title: Contractor Quote App
json.description_text:
Project Overview — Contractor Quote App MVP
Project Name (Optional): Contractor Quote App
Objective:
We want to build a web-based application that allows contractors to quickly generate professional construction quotes for clients. The app should use AI to assist with cost estimation and produce branded, editable PDFs that can be emailed directly to clients.
________________________________________
Core Features (MVP)
1.	User Registration / Login – Contractors can securely create accounts.
2.	Dashboard – Simple view of quotes: drafts, sent, accepted.
3.	New Quote Creation – Enter job description and client details.
4.	AI-Powered Estimate – The app generates a structured cost breakdown using AI (materials, labor, and other costs).
5.	Editable Quote Items – Contractors can manually adjust quantities, prices, or descriptions.
6.	PDF Export & Email – Generate a professional PDF of the quote and send directly to clients.
7.	Basic Client Management – Store client information for repeat use.
________________________________________
Optional / Future Features
•	Track client acceptance / decline of quotes.
•	Automatic reminders for unresponded quotes.
•	Digital signature for client approval.
•	Analytics: total quotes, revenue pipeline, accepted vs. rejected ratio.
________________________________________
Target Users
•	Small-to-medium contractors and sole traders in the construction industry.
________________________________________
Deliverables
•	Working web app MVP with all core features.
•	Fully functional AI-assisted quote generator.
•	Editable PDF export functionality.
•	Basic client management.
•	Source code and deployment instructions.
________________________________________
Timeline & Budget
•	Timeline: MVP expected in 2–3 months (negotiable)
•	Budget / Compensation Options:
o	Option 1: Pay a total of AUD $15,000–$20,000 for full development of the MVP.
o	Option 2: Offer 20% equity in the company instead of full payment, allowing the developer to share in future revenue and growth.
•	Both options are negotiable depending on experience, involvement, and contribution.
________________________________________
Investor Option
•	Separately, we are keeping the investor option open to raise additional funding to help cover development, marketing, and scaling costs.
________________________________________
Notes
•	Focus on ease of use and professional-looking quotes.
•	The AI cost estimation should be editable and transparent — contractors can modify quantities and rates.
•	MVP only; advanced features can be added later
•	The app at first will be free. But later will be a paid version to allow cashflow.

json.title: Trade Lane Manager (Retainer + Commission Model)
json.description_text:
Job Title

Trade Lane Manager (Retainer + Commission Model)

About Us

We are a logistics and supply-chain company looking to expand our trade lanes by building and managing customer and partner relationships. To help us grow, we want to bring on a motivated relationship-builder who can learn quickly, engage openly, and drive conversations forward.

Role Overview

You will be responsible for building, managing, and growing relationships across key markets. Unlike a standard salary role, this opportunity is structured as a retainer + commission arrangement: a fixed monthly retainer fee, plus commissions on revenue generated through the relationships you manage.
We propose a 12-month period at a higher commission rate for new relationships you develop, followed by a reduced “maintenance rate” commission on revenue that continues beyond the first year.
This role is about being outgoing, engaging, and people-focused—you don’t need prior industry experience. We’ll provide you with training and knowledge of how the sector works. Your focus is on connecting with people, creating opportunities, and moving prospects to the next step.

Responsibilities

Engage customers, prospects, and partners in a friendly, professional way
Build and nurture relationships within assigned trade lanes / groups
Learn the fundamentals of the logistics and freight industry to support conversations
Identify new opportunities and connect prospects to next steps in the process
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth on-boarding and handover
Track conversations and opportunities in a CRM or similar system
Provide simple progress updates and highlight new opportunities regularly

Required Qualities & Experience

We are not looking for someone with years of logistics experience. Instead, we want someone who is:
Outgoing, engaging, and approachable
A natural communicator who enjoys building relationships
Motivated to learn a new industry and pick up knowledge quickly
Results-oriented and proactive in following up conversations
Organized and reliable in tracking activity and progress
(Experience in logistics, sales, partnerships, or customer-facing roles is a plus, but not required.)

Compensation & Terms

Retainer + Commission Structure (example, flexible to negotiate):
Component Description
Monthly Retainer
Fixed monthly fee (e.g. AUD $1500) to cover base time, relationship management, and reporting
Commission (First 12 months)
Higher % commission on revenue generated from new and managed relationships
Commission (After 12 months)
Reduced % commission on continued revenue beyond 12 months
Review / Renewal Period
Agreement runs for 12 months, with review at end of period

What We’re Looking For

Someone who thrives on connecting with people
A friendly, professional communicator who can make conversations easy and engaging
Someone motivated to learn the logistics industry with our guidance
A partner who wants to grow alongside us and share in the results
